Gojoseon.name: King Jun
Gojoseon.note: Last king before Wiman; fled south to Mahan.
Gojoseon.note_zh: 卫满之前的末代国王，被逐后南逃马韩。

Gojoseon.name: Wiman
Gojoseon.note: Refugee from Yan who seized the throne, founding Wiman Joseon.
Gojoseon.note_zh: 从燕地流亡而来，夺取王位，建立卫满朝鲜。

Gojoseon.name: King Ugeo
Gojoseon.note: Grandson of Wiman; his state fell to Emperor Wu of Han.
Gojoseon.note_zh: 卫满之孙，其国被汉武帝所灭。

Koguryo.name: Dongmyeong (Jumong)
Koguryo.note: Traditional dates from the Samguk sagi.

Koguryo.name: Dongcheon
Koguryo.note: His capital was sacked by the Wei general Guanqiu Jian.
Koguryo.note_zh: 都城被曹魏将领毌丘俭攻破。

Koguryo.name: Micheon
Koguryo.note: Conquered the Han commandery of Lelang in 313.

Silla.name: Hyeokgeose
Silla.note_zh: 传说中的开国君主，传统纪年。

Silla.name: Michu
Silla.note: First king of the Kim clan.

Paekche.name: Onjo
Paekche.note_zh: 传说中的开国君主，传统纪年。

Gaya.name: Suro
Gaya.note_zh: 传说中金官伽倻的开国君主。

people.name: Jumong
people.known_for: Legendary founder of Goguryeo, said to have fled Buyeo and set up his kingdom at Jolbon.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中高句丽的开国君主，相传逃离扶余后在卒本建国。

people.name: Hyeokgeose
people.known_for: Legendary founder of Silla, said to have been born from an egg, and ancestor of the Park clan.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中新罗的开国君主，相传从卵中诞生，是朴氏的始祖。

people.name: Onjo
people.known_for: Legendary founder of Baekje, a son of Jumong who settled near the Han River.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中百济的开国君主，朱蒙之子，在汉江流域建国。

people.name: Suro
people.known_for: Legendary founder of Geumgwan Gaya and ancestor of the Gimhae Kim clan.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中金官伽倻的开国君主，金海金氏的始祖。

people.name: Eul Paso
people.known_for: Prime minister of King Gogukcheon who created a relief system lending grain to the poor in spring.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽故国川王的国相，推行春贷秋还的赈贷法。

people.name: King Micheon
people.known_for: Goguryeo king who drove out the Han commanderies, taking Lelang in 313.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽国王，313年攻灭乐浪郡，驱逐了汉朝设立的郡县。

Koguryo.name: Sosurim
Koguryo.note: Adopted Buddhism in 372 and founded a national academy.

Koguryo.name: Jangsu
Koguryo.note: Moved the capital to Pyongyang in 427.

Koguryo.name: Bojang
Koguryo.note: Last king; Goguryeo fell to Tang and Silla in 668.
Koguryo.note_zh: 末代国王，668年高句丽被唐朝和新罗所灭。

Paekche.name: Gaero
Paekche.note_zh: 高句丽攻陷汉城时被杀。

Paekche.name: Seong
Paekche.note: Moved the capital to Sabi (Buyeo) and sent Buddhism to Japan.
Paekche.note_zh: 迁都泗沘（今扶余），向日本传入佛教。

Paekche.name: Uija
Paekche.note: Last king; Baekje fell to Tang and Silla in 660.
Paekche.note_zh: 末代国王，660年百济被唐朝和新罗所灭。

Silla.name: Jijeung
Silla.note: Fixed the name Silla and the title king.
Silla.note_zh: 确定国号为新罗，改称王号。

Silla.name: Muyeol
Silla.note: Kim Chunchu; allied with Tang and conquered Baekje.
Silla.note_zh: 即金春秋，联合唐朝灭百济。

people.name: Gwanggaeto the Great
people.known_for: Goguryeo king who greatly expanded its territory in Manchuria and Korea, recorded on the Gwanggaeto Stele.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽国王，大举开拓疆土至东北和半岛南部，事迹刻于好太王碑。

people.name: Jangsu of Goguryeo
people.known_for: Goguryeo king who moved the capital to Pyongyang and took the Baekje capital Hanseong in 475.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽国王，迁都平壤，475年攻陷百济都城汉城。

people.name: Geunchogo of Baekje
people.known_for: Baekje king who brought it to its height, killed King Gogugwon of Goguryeo and opened ties with Eastern Jin and Wa.
people.known_for_zh: 使百济进入鼎盛的国王，击杀高句丽故国原王，与东晋和倭国建交。

people.name: Muryeong of Baekje
people.known_for: Baekje king whose rich, unlooted tomb at Gongju was found in 1971.
people.known_for_zh: 百济国王，其未被盗掘的陵墓1971年在公州被发现，出土大量珍宝。

people.name: Seong of Baekje
people.known_for: Baekje king who moved the capital to Sabi, sent Buddhism to Japan and died fighting Silla.
people.known_for_zh: 百济国王，迁都泗沘，向日本传入佛教，在与新罗作战中阵亡。

people.name: Jinheung of Silla
people.known_for: Silla king who seized the Han River valley, set up border stelae and founded the Hwarang.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗国王，夺取汉江流域，立巡狩碑，创设花郎制度。

people.name: Damjing
people.known_for: Goguryeo monk-painter who taught paper, ink and paint making in Japan.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽僧人画家，赴日传授造纸、制墨和颜料技术。

people.name: Queen Seondeok of Silla
people.known_for: First reigning queen of Silla, who built the Cheomseongdae observatory and Hwangnyongsa pagoda.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗第一位女王，兴建瞻星台和皇龙寺九层塔。

people.name: Jajang
people.known_for: Silla monk who studied in Tang and led the building of Hwangnyongsa's nine-storey pagoda.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗僧人，入唐求法，回国后主持修建皇龙寺九层塔。

people.name: Woncheuk
people.known_for: Silla monk who worked in Chang'an alongside Xuanzang and wrote major commentaries on Yogacara.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗僧人，在长安与玄奘同时代弘法，撰写了重要的唯识学注疏。

people.name: Yeon Gaesomun
people.known_for: Goguryeo dictator who seized power in 642 and repelled Emperor Taizong of Tang.
people.known_for_zh: 高句丽权臣，642年发动政变掌权，击退了唐太宗的进攻。

people.name: Kim Yu-sin
people.known_for: Silla general of Gaya royal descent who led the wars that unified the Three Kingdoms.
people.known_for_zh: 伽倻王族后裔出身的新罗名将，主导了统一三国的战争。

people.name: Muyeol of Silla
people.known_for: Kim Chunchu, the diplomat-king who allied Silla with Tang and conquered Baekje in 660.
people.known_for_zh: 即金春秋，以外交家身份促成罗唐联盟，660年灭百济。

people.name: Gyebaek
people.known_for: Baekje general who died with his 5,000 men fighting Silla at Hwangsanbeol.
people.known_for_zh: 百济将领，率五千决死之士在黄山伐与新罗军血战阵亡。

Silla.name: Munmu
Silla.note: Drove the Tang armies out by 676.

Balhae.name: Dae Insu
Balhae.note: Balhae was called the 'flourishing land of the east' in his time.
Balhae.note_zh: 此时渤海被称为“海东盛国”。

people.name: Munmu of Silla
people.known_for: Silla king who conquered Goguryeo with Tang, then drove Tang out and asked to be buried at sea to guard Silla.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗国王，联唐灭高句丽后又驱逐唐军，遗命海葬以护卫国家。

people.name: Wonhyo
people.known_for: Monk and thinker who wrote some 80 works and spread Buddhism among ordinary people.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人和思想家，著述约八十部，在平民中弘扬佛教。

people.name: Uisang
people.known_for: Monk who studied Huayan in Tang China and founded the Korean Hwaeom school at Buseoksa.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，入唐学习华严宗，回国在浮石寺开创海东华严宗。

people.name: Seol Chong
people.known_for: Son of Wonhyo, a Confucian scholar credited with the idu system of writing Korean with Chinese characters.
people.known_for_zh: 元晓之子，儒学家，相传创制了用汉字标记朝鲜语的吏读。

people.name: Kim Gyo-gak
people.known_for: Silla prince who became a monk on Mount Jiuhua in China and was venerated as an incarnation of Ksitigarbha.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗王子，在中国九华山出家修行，被尊为地藏菩萨的化身。

people.name: Hyecho
people.known_for: Monk who travelled to India and Central Asia and wrote an account found at Dunhuang.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，游历印度和中亚，所著游记在敦煌被发现。

works.title: Memoir of a Pilgrimage to the Five Kingdoms of India

people.name: Kim Daeseong
people.known_for: Chief minister who built the Bulguksa temple and Seokguram grotto.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗宰相，主持兴建佛国寺和石窟庵。

people.name: Kim Saeng
people.known_for: Calligrapher praised as the finest of Silla.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家，被誉为新罗第一书家。

people.name: Dae Joyeong
people.known_for: Former Goguryeo general who founded Balhae in 698 and was named King of Bohai by the Tang.
people.known_for_zh: 原高句丽将领，698年建立渤海国，被唐朝册封为渤海郡王。

people.name: Mun of Balhae
people.known_for: Balhae king who reigned 57 years, adopted Tang institutions and moved the capital to Sanggyeong.
people.known_for_zh: 渤海国王，在位五十七年，仿效唐制，迁都上京龙泉府。

people.name: Jang Bogo
people.known_for: Sea lord who suppressed pirates and dominated trade among Silla, Tang and Japan from Cheonghaejin.
people.known_for_zh: 海上霸主，以清海镇为基地剿灭海盗，掌控新罗、唐朝和日本之间的贸易。

people.name: Doseon
people.known_for: Monk who founded Korean geomancy (pungsu).
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，被视为朝鲜风水地理说的开创者。

people.name: Choe Chiwon
people.known_for: Scholar who passed the Tang examination, wrote the famous proclamation against Huang Chao and returned to Silla.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，考中唐朝科举，曾撰《讨黄巢檄文》，后返回新罗。

Silla.name: Gyeongae
Silla.note: Killed when Gyeon Hwon sacked Gyeongju.

Balhae.name: Dae Inseon
Balhae.note: Last king; Balhae fell to the Khitan in 926.
Balhae.note_zh: 末代国王，926年渤海被契丹所灭。

people.name: Gyeon Hwon
people.known_for: Silla officer who founded Later Baekje, sacked Gyeongju, and was later overthrown by his son.
people.known_for_zh: 新罗将领出身，建立后百济，曾攻破庆州，后被儿子篡位。

people.name: Gung Ye
people.known_for: Silla prince turned rebel monk who founded Taebong, then was overthrown by his generals.
people.known_for_zh: 据说是新罗王子，出家后起兵建立泰封，后被部将推翻。

people.name: Taejo of Goryeo
people.known_for: Founder of Goryeo who reunified the peninsula in 936 and left the Ten Injunctions to his heirs.
people.known_for_zh: 高丽开国君主，936年重新统一半岛，留下《训要十条》。

Goryeo.name: Gwangjong
Goryeo.note: Introduced the civil service examination in 958.

Goryeo.name: Hyeonjong
Goryeo.note_zh: 在位期间抵御契丹入侵。

Goryeo.name: Uijong
Goryeo.note: Deposed in the military coup of 1170.

Goryeo.name: Gojong
Goryeo.note: Court moved to Ganghwa Island during the Mongol invasions.
Goryeo.note_zh: 蒙古入侵期间朝廷迁往江华岛。

Goryeo.name: Chungnyeol
Goryeo.note: First king married to a Yuan princess.
Goryeo.note_zh: 第一位迎娶元朝公主的国王。

Goryeo.name: Gongmin
Goryeo.note: Broke with the Yuan and recovered northern lands.
Goryeo.note_zh: 摆脱元朝控制，收复北方领土。

Goryeo.name: Gongyang
Goryeo.note: Last king; deposed by Yi Seong-gye.
Goryeo.note_zh: 末代国王，被李成桂废黜。

people.name: Gwangjong of Goryeo
people.known_for: King who freed slaves taken unjustly and introduced the civil service examination to curb the great families.
people.known_for_zh: 高丽国王，颁布奴婢按检法，实行科举，以削弱豪族势力。

people.name: Choe Seung-ro
people.known_for: Confucian minister whose 28-point memorial set the course of Goryeo government.
people.known_for_zh: 儒臣，上呈《时务二十八条》，奠定了高丽的治国方针。

people.name: Seo Hui
people.known_for: Diplomat who talked the Khitan army into withdrawing in 993 and gained land south of the Yalu.
people.known_for_zh: 外交家，993年说服契丹退兵，并取得鸭绿江以东的江东六州。

people.name: Gang Gam-chan
people.known_for: General who crushed the Khitan invasion at the Battle of Gwiju in 1019.
people.known_for_zh: 将领，1019年在龟州大捷中击溃契丹入侵军。

people.name: Choe Chung
people.known_for: Scholar who founded the first private academy in Goryeo, called the Confucius of the East.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，创办高丽第一所私学，被称为“海东孔子”。

people.name: Uicheon
people.known_for: Prince-monk who studied in Song China and founded the Korean Cheontae school.
people.known_for_zh: 王子出家为僧，入宋求法，回国开创高丽天台宗。

people.name: Kim Busik
people.known_for: Statesman and historian who compiled the Samguk sagi, Korea's oldest surviving history.
people.known_for_zh: 政治家和史学家，主持编纂朝鲜现存最早的史书《三国史记》。

people.name: Jeong Jung-bu
people.known_for: General who led the military coup of 1170 that began a century of military rule.
people.known_for_zh: 将领，发动1170年武臣政变，开启了约百年的武臣政权。

people.name: Jinul
people.known_for: Monk who reformed Korean Seon (Zen) and founded the Jogye tradition at Songgwangsa.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，革新禅宗，在松广寺奠定曹溪宗传统。

people.name: Choe Chung-heon
people.known_for: Military strongman whose family ruled Goryeo for sixty years.
people.known_for_zh: 武臣权臣，其家族掌控高丽政权达六十年。

people.name: Yi Gyu-bo
people.known_for: Poet and official whose works include an epic of King Dongmyeong and a record of metal type printing.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人和官员，作品包括《东明王篇》，并记载了金属活字印刷。

people.name: Iryeon
people.known_for: Monk who wrote the Samguk yusa, which preserves the Dangun myth and old legends.
people.known_for_zh: 僧人，著《三国遗事》，保存了檀君神话和许多古代传说。

people.name: An Hyang
people.known_for: Scholar who brought Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucianism from Yuan to Korea.
people.known_for_zh: 学者，从元朝引入朱子学。

people.name: Yi Je-hyeon
people.known_for: Scholar and poet who lived at the Yuan court in Dadu and later served as chief minister.
people.known_for_zh: 学者和诗人，曾长期在元大都与中国文人交游，后任宰相。

people.name: Baegun
people.known_for: Seon monk whose anthology Jikji, printed in 1377, is the oldest surviving book printed with metal type.
people.known_for_zh: 禅僧，其编著的《直指》1377年刊印，是现存最早的金属活字印本。

works.title: Jikji
works.title_zh: 白云和尚抄录佛祖直指心体要节

people.name: Choe Yeong
people.known_for: General who fought the Red Turbans and Japanese pirates and was executed by Yi Seong-gye.
people.known_for_zh: 将领，抗击红巾军和倭寇，后被李成桂处死。

people.name: Gongmin of Goryeo
people.known_for: King who threw off Yuan control and attempted reforms with the monk Sin Don.
people.known_for_zh: 高丽国王，摆脱元朝控制，并任用僧人辛旽推行改革。

people.name: Choe Mu-seon
people.known_for: Inventor who learned to make gunpowder and armed ships with cannon against Japanese pirates.
people.known_for_zh: 发明家，研制火药，用火炮装备战船抗击倭寇。

people.name: Yi Saek
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian scholar who taught a generation of officials.
people.known_for_zh: 朱子学者，培养了一代士大夫。

people.name: Mun Ik-jeom
people.known_for: Official who brought cotton seeds from Yuan China and began cotton growing in Korea.
people.known_for_zh: 官员，从元朝带回棉花种子，开创了朝鲜半岛的棉花种植。

people.name: Jeong Mong-ju
people.known_for: Loyal minister and scholar killed for refusing to support the new Joseon dynasty.
people.known_for_zh: 忠臣和学者，因拒绝支持李成桂建立新王朝而被杀。

Korea.name: Sejo of Joseon
Korea.note: Seized the throne from his nephew Danjong.
Korea.note_zh: 从侄子端宗手中篡夺王位。

Korea.name: Seonjo of Joseon
Korea.note: Reign of the Japanese invasions of 1592 and 1597.
Korea.note_zh: 在位期间发生1592年和1597年日本入侵（壬辰倭乱）。

people.name: Taejo of Joseon
people.known_for: General who turned back from the Liaodong campaign in 1388, founded Joseon in 1392 and moved the capital to Hanseong.
people.known_for_zh: 将领，1388年威化岛回军，1392年建立朝鲜王朝，迁都汉城。

people.name: Jeong Do-jeon
people.known_for: Chief architect of the Joseon state, its Confucian laws and the plan of Hanseong.
people.known_for_zh: 朝鲜王朝的总设计师，制定儒家治国制度，规划汉城。

people.name: Sejong the Great
people.known_for: King who created the Hangul alphabet and sponsored science, music and the Hall of Worthies.
people.known_for_zh: 朝鲜国王，创制训民正音（韩文字母），倡导科学和音乐，设立集贤殿。

people.name: Jang Yeong-sil
people.known_for: Engineer of humble birth who built water clocks, sundials and the rain gauge for King Sejong.
people.known_for_zh: 出身低微的工匠，为世宗制作了自击漏、日晷和测雨器。

people.name: Sin Suk-ju
people.known_for: Scholar of the Hall of Worthies who helped create Hangul and wrote an account of Japan.
people.known_for_zh: 集贤殿学士，参与创制训民正音，著有《海东诸国纪》。

people.name: Hwang Jini
people.known_for: Gisaeng of Kaesong famed for her sijo poems.
people.known_for_zh: 开城的名妓，以时调诗闻名。

check.n: Dates uncertain; Wikipedia gives 1506-1567, Wikidata death 1544.
check.n_zh: 生卒不确定；维基百科作1506-1567年，维基数据卒年作1544年。

people.name: Sin Saimdang
people.known_for: Painter and calligrapher, mother of Yi I, honoured as a model mother.
people.known_for_zh: 画家和书法家，李珥之母，被尊为贤母典范。

people.name: Yi Hwang
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian philosopher known as Toegye, the leading thinker of Korean Confucianism.
people.known_for_zh: 号退溪，朱子学大家，朝鲜儒学最重要的思想家。

people.name: Yi I
people.known_for: Neo-Confucian philosopher known as Yulgok, who urged reforms and military preparation.
people.known_for_zh: 号栗谷，朱子学大家，主张改革时弊、加强国防。

people.name: Yu Seong-ryong
people.known_for: Prime minister during the Imjin War who promoted Yi Sun-sin and wrote a record of the war.
people.known_for_zh: 壬辰倭乱时的领议政，举荐李舜臣，著有战争回忆录《惩毖录》。

people.name: Yi Sun-sin
people.known_for: Admiral who defeated the Japanese navy with turtle ships in the Imjin War and died at Noryang.
people.known_for_zh: 海军将领，在壬辰倭乱中用龟船击败日本水军，在露梁海战中阵亡。

people.name: Gwak Jae-u
people.known_for: First leader of a righteous army against the Japanese, called the Red-Robed General.
people.known_for_zh: 壬辰倭乱中最早起兵的义兵将，号称“红衣将军”。

people.name: Heo Jun
people.known_for: Royal physician who wrote the Dongui bogam, the classic of Korean medicine.
people.known_for_zh: 御医，著有东医经典《东医宝鉴》。

people.name: Heo Nanseolheon
people.known_for: Woman poet whose Chinese-language poems were published in Ming China after her early death.
people.known_for_zh: 女诗人，早逝后其汉诗集在明朝刊行。

people.name: Heo Gyun
people.known_for: Writer credited with The Tale of Hong Gildong, the first novel in Hangul; executed for treason.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，相传著有第一部韩文小说《洪吉童传》，后以谋反罪被处死。

people.name: Song Si-yeol
people.known_for: Leading Neo-Confucian of the Westerners faction who championed loyalty to the fallen Ming.
people.known_for_zh: 西人派领袖、朱子学大家，主张尊明反清。

people.name: Jeong Seon
people.known_for: Painter who created true-view landscapes of real Korean scenery.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，开创描绘朝鲜真实山川的“真景山水”。

people.name: Yeongjo of Joseon
people.known_for: King who reigned 52 years, balanced the factions and had his son Crown Prince Sado put to death.
people.known_for_zh: 在位五十二年的国王，推行荡平策调和党争，处死了儿子思悼世子。

people.name: Pak Ji-won
people.known_for: Silhak writer whose Jehol Diary recorded his journey to the Qing court.
people.known_for_zh: 实学派作家，所著《热河日记》记录了出使清朝的见闻。

people.name: Kim Hong-do
people.known_for: Painter of lively scenes of everyday Korean life.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，以生动描绘朝鲜百姓日常生活的风俗画闻名。

people.name: Jeongjo of Joseon
people.known_for: Reforming king who founded the Gyujanggak library and built Hwaseong Fortress at Suwon.
people.known_for_zh: 改革君主，设立奎章阁，修建水原华城。

people.name: Sin Yun-bok
people.known_for: Painter of genre scenes of romance and city life.
people.known_for_zh: 风俗画家，擅长描绘男女风情和都市生活。

people.name: Jeong Yak-yong
people.known_for: Leading Silhak scholar who wrote some 500 works in exile on government and reform.
people.known_for_zh: 实学集大成者，流放期间写下约五百卷论治国与改革的著作。

people.name: Kim Jeong-hui
people.known_for: Calligrapher and epigraphist who created the Chusa style; painted Sehando in exile on Jeju.
people.known_for_zh: 书法家和金石学家，创立“秋史体”，在济州流放期间画下《岁寒图》。

people.name: Kim Jeong-ho
people.known_for: Geographer who made the detailed Daedong yeojido map of Korea.
people.known_for_zh: 地理学家，绘制了精细的朝鲜全图《大东舆地图》。

people.name: Choe Je-u
people.known_for: Founder of the Donghak religion, executed in 1864.
people.known_for_zh: 东学的创始人，1864年被处死。

people.name: Heungseon Daewongun
people.known_for: Regent for his son Gojong who rebuilt Gyeongbokgung and fought off French and American expeditions.
people.known_for_zh: 高宗之父，摄政期间重建景福宫，击退法国和美国舰队，推行锁国。

people.name: Kim Ok-gyun
people.known_for: Reformer who led the failed Gapsin Coup of 1884 and was assassinated in Shanghai.
people.known_for_zh: 开化派领袖，1884年发动甲申政变失败，后在上海遇刺。

people.name: Empress Myeongseong
people.known_for: Queen of Gojong and a power at court, murdered by Japanese agents in 1895.
people.known_for_zh: 高宗的王后，在朝中权势很大，1895年被日本人杀害。

people.name: Jeon Bong-jun
people.known_for: Leader of the Donghak Peasant Revolution of 1894, which led to the First Sino-Japanese War.
people.known_for_zh: 1894年东学农民运动的领袖，这场起义引发了甲午战争。

Korea.name: Gojong (Gwangmu Emperor)
Korea.note: Forced to abdicate by Japan after the Hague envoy affair.
Korea.note_zh: 海牙密使事件后被日本逼迫退位。

Korea.name: Sunjong (Yunghui Emperor)
Korea.note: Korea was annexed by Japan in 1910.

people.name: Gojong of Korea
people.known_for: Last king of Joseon and first emperor of Korea, who tried to keep Korea independent; his death sparked the March First Movement.
people.known_for_zh: 朝鲜王朝末代国王和大韩帝国首位皇帝，力图维护独立，其去世引发三一运动。

people.name: Seo Jae-pil
people.known_for: Reformer who founded The Independent, the first Hangul newspaper, and the Independence Club.
people.known_for_zh: 改革家，创办第一份韩文报纸《独立新闻》和独立协会。

people.name: Choe Ik-hyeon
people.known_for: Confucian scholar who raised a righteous army against Japan at over seventy and died in captivity on Tsushima.
people.known_for_zh: 儒学者，七十多岁时起兵抗日，被俘后死于对马岛。

people.name: Min Yeong-hwan
people.known_for: Official who killed himself in protest against the Eulsa Treaty of 1905.
people.known_for_zh: 官员，为抗议1905年《乙巳条约》而自尽。

people.name: Jang Ji-yeon
people.known_for: Journalist whose editorial 'Today we cry out' condemned the Eulsa Treaty.
people.known_for_zh: 记者，发表社论《是日也放声大哭》谴责《乙巳条约》。

people.name: Yi Jun
people.known_for: Secret envoy sent by Gojong to the Hague Peace Conference in 1907, who died there.
people.known_for_zh: 1907年被高宗秘密派往海牙万国和平会议的特使，死于海牙。

people.name: Yi Wan-yong
people.known_for: Prime minister who signed the treaties giving Korea to Japan, remembered as a traitor.
people.known_for_zh: 签署将韩国出卖给日本的条约的总理大臣，被视为卖国贼。

people.name: An Jung-geun
people.known_for: Independence fighter who shot Itō Hirobumi at Harbin station in 1909.
people.known_for_zh: 独立运动家，1909年在哈尔滨火车站击毙伊藤博文。

people.name: Ju Si-gyeong
people.known_for: Linguist who standardised Hangul grammar and gave the alphabet its name.
people.known_for_zh: 语言学家，规范韩文语法，并首创“韩文”这一名称。

Provisional Government of the Republic o.name: Syngman Rhee
Provisional Government of the Republic o.note: Impeached by the provisional assembly in 1925.

Provisional Government of the Republic o.name: Kim Gu
Provisional Government of the Republic o.note: Led the government in Chongqing during the war.
Provisional Government of the Republic o.note_zh: 抗战期间在重庆领导临时政府。

people.name: Son Byong-hi
people.known_for: Leader of Cheondogyo and chief signer of the March First Declaration of Independence in 1919.
people.known_for_zh: 天道教教主，1919年三一独立宣言的首要签署人。

people.name: Han Yong-un
people.known_for: Buddhist monk, poet and signer of the March First Declaration.
people.known_for_zh: 佛教僧人和诗人，三一独立宣言签署人之一。

people.name: Choe Nam-seon
people.known_for: Writer who drafted the March First Declaration and pioneered modern Korean poetry.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，起草三一独立宣言，开创韩国新体诗。

people.name: Yu Gwan-sun
people.known_for: Schoolgirl who led a March First protest and died in Seodaemun Prison.
people.known_for_zh: 女学生，领导三一运动示威，死于西大门监狱。

people.name: Ahn Changho
people.known_for: Independence leader and educator who founded the Young Korean Academy.
people.known_for_zh: 独立运动领袖和教育家，创立兴士团。

people.name: Sin Chae-ho
people.known_for: Historian and anarchist who wrote nationalist histories of ancient Korea.
people.known_for_zh: 史学家和无政府主义者，撰写民族主义的朝鲜古代史。

people.name: Hong Beom-do
people.known_for: Independence army commander who won the Battle of Fengwudong in 1920.
people.known_for_zh: 独立军将领，1920年赢得凤梧洞战斗。

people.name: Kim Jwa-jin
people.known_for: Commander who defeated the Japanese army at Qingshanli in Manchuria in 1920.
people.known_for_zh: 独立军将领，1920年在中国东北青山里击败日军。

people.name: Kim Gu
people.known_for: Leader of the Provisional Government in Shanghai and Chongqing; assassinated in 1949.
people.known_for_zh: 大韩民国临时政府领导人，先后在上海和重庆坚持抗日，1949年遇刺。

people.name: Yi Bong-chang
people.known_for: Independence fighter who threw a grenade at Emperor Hirohito in Tokyo in 1932.
people.known_for_zh: 独立运动家，1932年在东京向裕仁天皇投掷手榴弹。

people.name: Yun Bong-gil
people.known_for: Independence fighter whose bomb at Hongkou Park in Shanghai in 1932 killed Japanese commanders.
people.known_for_zh: 独立运动家，1932年在上海虹口公园投掷炸弹，炸死炸伤多名日军高官。

people.name: Yeo Un-hyeong
people.known_for: Independence activist who formed the Committee for the Preparation of Korean Independence in 1945.
people.known_for_zh: 独立运动家，1945年组建建国准备委员会。

people.name: Kim Won-bong
people.known_for: Leader of the Heroic Corps and the Korean Volunteer Corps in China.
people.known_for_zh: 义烈团团长，在中国组建朝鲜义勇队。

people.name: Yi Kwang-su
people.known_for: Author of Heartless, the first modern Korean novel; later collaborated with Japan.
people.known_for_zh: 作家，著有第一部韩国现代小说《无情》，后来投靠日本。

people.name: Na Hye-sok
people.known_for: First Korean woman oil painter and a feminist writer.
people.known_for_zh: 韩国第一位女性油画家和女权主义作家。

people.name: Yi Sang
people.known_for: Modernist poet and novelist of experimental works such as Wings.
people.known_for_zh: 现代主义诗人和小说家，代表作有实验性小说《翅膀》。

people.name: Sohn Kee-chung
people.known_for: Marathon runner who won gold at the 1936 Berlin Olympics, forced to run for Japan.
people.known_for_zh: 马拉松运动员，1936年被迫以日本代表身份夺得柏林奥运会金牌。

people.name: Yun Dong-ju
people.known_for: Poet from the Korean community in Manchuria who died in a Japanese prison.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于中国东北朝鲜族社区的诗人，死于日本福冈监狱。

Korea, Democratic People's Republic of.name_zh: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国

Korea, Republic of.name: Syngman Rhee
Korea, Republic of.note: Driven out by the April Revolution.

Korea, Republic of.name: Yoon Suk Yeol
Korea, Republic of.note: Removed after declaring martial law in December 2024.
Korea, Republic of.note_zh: 2024年12月宣布戒严后遭弹劾罢免。

people.name: Syngman Rhee
people.known_for: First president of South Korea who led it through the Korean War and fell in the 1960 April Revolution.
people.known_for_zh: 韩国首任总统，领导韩国度过朝鲜战争，1960年在四一九革命中下台。

people.name: Kim Il Sung
people.known_for: Founder of North Korea who launched the Korean War in 1950 and ruled until his death.
people.known_for_zh: 朝鲜的建立者，1950年发动朝鲜战争，统治朝鲜直至去世。

people.name: Paik Sun-yup
people.known_for: South Korean general who held the Nakdong line in 1950 and became the first four-star general.
people.known_for_zh: 韩国将领，1950年守住洛东江防线，成为韩国首位四星上将。

people.name: Park Chung-hee
people.known_for: General who seized power in 1961 and drove rapid industrialisation under authoritarian rule; assassinated.
people.known_for_zh: 军人，1961年发动政变掌权，以威权统治推动经济高速工业化，1979年遇刺。

people.name: Kim Jong Il
people.known_for: Leader of North Korea from 1994 who pursued nuclear weapons during famine.
people.known_for_zh: 1994年起领导朝鲜，在饥荒时期推进核武器计划。

people.name: Jeon Tae-il
people.known_for: Garment worker who burned himself to death demanding labour rights, inspiring the labour movement.
people.known_for_zh: 制衣工人，为争取劳动权利自焚，激励了韩国劳工运动。

people.name: Chung Ju-yung
people.known_for: Founder of Hyundai who built ships, cars and roads for the 'Miracle on the Han River'.
people.known_for_zh: 现代集团创始人，以造船、汽车和建筑推动“汉江奇迹”。

people.name: Lee Byung-chul
people.known_for: Founder of Samsung.
people.known_for_zh: 三星集团创始人。

people.name: Lee Kun-hee
people.known_for: Chairman who made Samsung a world leader in electronics.
people.known_for_zh: 三星集团会长，使三星成为世界领先的电子企业。

people.name: Kim Dae-jung
people.known_for: Democracy activist and president who held the first inter-Korean summit; Nobel Peace Prize 2000.
people.known_for_zh: 民主运动人士，任总统时实现首次南北首脑会晤，获2000年诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Kim Young-sam
people.known_for: Opposition leader who became the first civilian president in three decades.
people.known_for_zh: 反对派领袖，成为三十余年来第一位文人总统。

people.name: Chun Doo-hwan
people.known_for: General who seized power in 1979 and crushed the Gwangju Uprising in 1980.
people.known_for_zh: 军人，1979年政变夺权，1980年镇压光州民主化运动。

people.name: Roh Moo-hyun
people.known_for: Human-rights lawyer who became president from 2003 to 2008.
people.known_for_zh: 人权律师出身，2003年至2008年任韩国总统。

people.name: Stephen Kim Sou-hwan
people.known_for: First Korean cardinal, a moral voice of the democracy movement.
people.known_for_zh: 韩国第一位枢机主教，民主化运动中的道德声音。

people.name: Lee Jung-seob
people.known_for: Painter famous for his bull paintings, made in poverty during and after the war.
people.known_for_zh: 画家，以在战乱和贫困中创作的《牛》系列闻名。

people.name: Isang Yun
people.known_for: Composer who joined East Asian and Western music; kidnapped by Seoul's agents from Berlin in 1967.
people.known_for_zh: 作曲家，融合东西方音乐，1967年曾被韩国情报机构从柏林绑架回国。

people.name: Park Kyung-ni
people.known_for: Novelist of the 16-volume family saga Land.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，著有长达十六卷的家族史诗《土地》。

people.name: Nam June Paik
people.known_for: Founder of video art.
people.known_for_zh: 影像艺术的开创者。

people.name: Ban Ki-moon
people.known_for: Secretary-General of the United Nations from 2007 to 2016.
people.known_for_zh: 2007年至2016年任联合国秘书长。

people.name: Bong Joon-ho
people.known_for: Film director whose Parasite won the Oscar for best picture in 2020.
people.known_for_zh: 电影导演，其《寄生虫》获2020年奥斯卡最佳影片。

people.name: Han Kang
people.known_for: Novelist who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2024.
people.known_for_zh: 小说家，2024年获诺贝尔文学奖。

people.name: Kim Jong Un
people.known_for: Leader of North Korea since 2011 who expanded its nuclear and missile programmes.
people.known_for_zh: 2011年起领导朝鲜，大力发展核武器和导弹。
